manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Gravity slows the ball on the way up and speeds it up on the way down. At the top, the ball is still for an instant while gravity is still pulling it downward.
manifest.description: A tossed ball moves vertically against a fixed height scale. Velocity and acceleration vectors are drawn beside it along with live motion readouts.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows. Press Play again to watch the ball fall, or drag the timeline to inspect any moment.
